l1_connect_account.title: Bring the clusters nobody manages centrally under the console
l1_connect_account.why: The cluster runs production, but the central console does not see it, so its health, protection and upgrades go unchecked.
steps: Find who runs each cluster, including remote offices and edge sites.
Register the cluster with the central console using a read-only service account.
Confirm the cluster reports hosts, virtual machines and alerts.
l1_connect_account.success: Every cluster in scope reports to the central console.
